expertiseSources.summary: Defines applicable STRIDE, authorization, injection, data-flow, secret-exposure, resource-exhaustion, and ambient-credential CSRF checks without bearer-only false positives.

exception.rationale: This threat-review workflow traces untrusted entry points to privileged sinks, preserves credential and live-system boundaries, and distinguishes confirmed exploits from speculation and unassessed scope. Conditional CSRF checks cover ambient browser credentials without inventing bearer-only findings or authorizing remediation or probing. This requests a safety exception for risk reduction; no assurance of unreviewed code, comparative uplift, or human approval is claimed.
